 "order_bonus_percent": "10", "subscription_bonus_percent": "10",
 "total_earned": "48.20", "earned_orders": "36.20", "earned_subscriptions": "12.00",
 "referral_count": 14, "active_referral_count": 5, "notifications_enabled": true}
Field Description order_bonus_percent, subscription_bonus_percent Your percentage of your referrals' orders and subscriptions (a string) total_earned Earned in total: earned_orders + earned_subscriptions active_referral_count Referrals who have already earned you a bonus notifications_enabled Whether bonus notifications are on

docs.title: Get the team
docs.text:
GEThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/team

Your team of executors and a page of its members. The response doesn't include the invite link.

Right: read

Parameter Type Required Description limit, offset integer no Page of members

Response 200:

{"stats": {"members_total": 3, "members_active": 2, "active_slots": 4, "graded": 40, "passed": 36},
 "limits": {"max_slots_per_order": 10, "max_active_slots": 20},
 "members": {"items": [{"id": "3310-7742", "worker_id": "7731-0045", "username": "worker_anna",
   "is_active": true, "max_slots_per_order": 5, "max_active_slots": null, "allowed_countries": ["UA", "KZ"],
   "joined_at": "2026-09-02T08:00:00Z", "active_slots": 2, "graded": 25, "passed": 23, "success_rate": 0.92}],
  "total": 3, "offset": 0, "limit": 20}}
Field Description graded, passed Attempts with an outcome / how many of them succeeded limits The highest limits you can set for a member; 0 — no limit members.items[].id The team membership number members.items[].max_slots_per_order, max_active_slots The member's limits; null — no limit members.items[].success_rate The share of successful attempts, from 0 to 1; null if there are no outcomes yet

docs.title: Get platform links
docs.text:
GEThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/info

Platform links: support, documentation, FAQ, terms, video and upload guides. Any link can be null.

Right: read

Response 200:

{"help_url": "https://t.me/freidbase", "docs_url": "https://portal-ss.github.io/docs/",
 "faq_url": "https://portal-ss.github.io/docs/faq/", "terms_url": "https://portal-ss.github.io/docs/terms/",
 "video_guide_url": null, "upload_guide_adspower_url": null, "upload_guide_manual_url": null}

docs.title: Cancellations
docs.text: A refund is credited to your balance: the full slot price, split between the main and referral balance in the same proportion as the payment. It arrives in the feed as a balance event with balance_event: "refund" (events). Initial-verification slots in a published order, except frozen ones, can't be cancelled: an executor fulfills them, or the platform closes them with a refund (Cancellations and refunds).

docs.title: Cancel an unpublished order
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/{order_id}/cancel

Cancels an unpublished order as a whole; the full amount is refunded right away. A re-verification order can't be cancelled this way — the response is 404 order_not_found.

Right: money · Idempotency-Key required

Response 200:

{"status": "cancelled", "cancelled_slots": 10, "refunded": "100.00", "order_id": "8402-9173"}
HTTP code When 409 order_not_cancellable The order is published or closed, or there's nothing to cancel

docs.title: Cancel frozen slots
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/{order_id}/cancel-frozen

Cancels the order's frozen slots — the untaken slots of a published wholesale or team order while the subscription isn't active. Slots for which no verification link was issued are cancelled with an immediate refund; the rest, after the exchange is checked.

Right: money · Idempotency-Key required

Body field Type Required Description expected_count integer yes frozen_slots − frozen_checking_slots from GET /orders/{order_id} expected_to_check integer yes frozen_needs_check from the same response 
curl -X POST https://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/8402-9173/cancel-frozen \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"expected_count": 4, "expected_to_check": 1}'

Response 200:

{"order_id": "8402-9173", "cancelled": 3, "refunded": "24.00", "checking": 1, "waiting_reupload": 0}
Response field Description cancelled, refunded Cancelled and refunded right away checking Waiting for an exchange check: not passed — the slot is cancelled and the money refunded later; passed — the slot completes without a refund waiting_reupload The part of checking that is waiting for your re-upload; the exchange is checked after it HTTP code When 409 frozen_cancel_changed The numbers didn't match the order — nothing was cancelled; re-read the order 409 nothing_to_cancel The subscription is active again, there are no frozen slots, or all of them are already being cancelled

docs.title: Cancel a re-verification slot
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/{order_id}/slots/{slot_id}/cancel-reverify

Cancels a re-verification slot. The cancel field of the slot card shows whether you can cancel right now and when cancellation opens; it usually opens min_hours hours after the current attempt started.

Right: money · Idempotency-Key required

Response 200:

{"status": "cancel_pending", "slot_id": "3307-1185", "refunded": null}
status What it means cancelled No link was issued for the slot: the slot is cancelled, refunded is the refund amount cancel_pending A link was issued: the platform will check the exchange in 10 minutes. Not passed — the slot is cancelled with a refund; passed — the slot completes without a refund cancel_checking The cancellation is waiting for the exchange's answer, your re-upload or a manual review

The outcome arrives in the feed: slot_status CANCELLED with reason: "client_cancel" and a balance event with the refund — or slot_status COMPLETED.

HTTP code When 409 reverify_cancel_too_early Cancellation hasn't opened yet; min_hours is how many hours after the attempt starts it opens 409 reverify_cancel_needs_reupload The slot is waiting for a re-upload — do that first 409 reverify_cancel_after_face Risk Removal: the face check has passed, only support can cancel 409 reverify_cancel_forbidden In this state, support is handling the slot 409 slot_already_closed The slot is already closed 409 cancel_blocked_admin_review Support is already closing this slot — you'll be notified of the outcome 404 slot_not_found Also returned for a slot that isn't a re-verification

docs.title: Slot statuses
docs.text:
The slot's status field and the slot_status event.

Value What it means FREE Nobody has taken the slot: it's empty, has an account uploaded or is waiting for an executor after publishing IN_PROGRESS An executor has taken the slot and is completing the verification PENDING The exchange is reviewing the verification; deadlines are paused VERIFICATION_FAILED The exchange rejected the attempt, and the executor is retrying REUPLOAD_REQUIRED A fresh proxy, fresh cookies or both are needed; the slot is paused — re-upload MEXC_HOLD MEXC: the verification has passed, and the platform is waiting to see whether the exchange asks for a face check MEXC_FACE_REQUIRED MEXC has asked for a face check, and the executor is passing it at no extra charge BINGX_FACE_OFF BingX: KYC has passed, and the second stage is under way — turning off face login BINGX_REVIEW BingX: KYC has passed, but the slot couldn't be completed automatically; support is reviewing it RISK_AWAITING_DOCUMENT Risk Removal: the appeal is being prepared RISK_SUBMITTED Risk Removal: the appeal has been filed with MEXC RISK_FACE_EXPIRED Risk Removal: the face check has to be passed again; the same executor does it RISK_REJECTED Risk Removal: MEXC closed the appeal without lifting the restriction; support decides on the next steps RISK_ERROR Risk Removal: there's a problem with the appeal, and support is handling it COMPLETED The slot is completed CANCELLED The slot is closed; the reason is in close_reason

docs.title: Order statuses
docs.text:
The order's status field, the slot's order_status and the order_status event.

Value What it means PAID Paid, waiting for accounts to be uploaded SESSION_UPLOADED Every slot has an account, and the order is waiting to be published IN_PROGRESS Published; not all slots are closed yet COMPLETED All slots are completed PARTIAL_COMPLETED All slots are closed: some completed, some cancelled CANCELLED All slots are closed, none completed

Very old orders may have the obsolete values ACCESS_GRANTED, IN_POOL, PARTIAL, REFUNDED, MANUAL.

docs.title: Verification outcome
docs.text:
The slot's verification_result field. Values differ in letter case — compare the strings exactly as they are.

Value What it means passed Passed pending The exchange is still reviewing wrong_country Wrong country blocked The exchange doesn't allow verification on the account kyc_already_done The account had already been verified no_challenge_required No check was required admin_cancelled Cancelled by support DEADLINE_EXPIRED The deadline expired ACCOUNT_UNSERVABLE The exchange doesn't accept this account CLIENT_CANCELLED Cancelled by you failed, SUBSCRIPTION_LAPSED Obsolete, found only on old slots

docs.title: What the slot needs from you
docs.text:
The slot's waiting_for_client field is a list. It's non-empty for exactly the slots that GET /slots?attention=true returns.

Value When What to do reupload The slot is in REUPLOAD_REQUIRED status Send what reupload_scope says (below) risk_proofs New deposit screenshots are needed for Risk Removal Send the screenshots bingx_code A BINGX_FACE_OFF slot is waiting for the code from the BingX email Send the code

reupload and risk_proofs can be present at the same time. A slot waiting for a re-upload waits only for that — even if it was asking for a BingX code before.

The reupload_scope field — what to send on a re-upload:

Value What to send Method proxy A new proxy replace-proxy session Fresh cookies from the same account reupload full Both cookies and a proxy reupload

docs.title: What needs to be done
docs.text:
The action field of the slot_action_required event.

Value What it means What to do bingx_code BingX has emailed the account a code for the second stage Send the code risk_proofs New deposit screenshots are needed for Risk Removal Send the screenshots

docs.title: Request reasons
docs.text:
The reason field of the slot_action_required event and the slot's bingx.code_ask_reason. For any code request, send the code from the latest BingX email.

Value What it means first The first request: KYC has passed, and BingX has just sent the code new_code_sent BingX sent the code again wrong_code The code you sent didn't work — check it and send it again wrong_code_resent The code didn't work again, and BingX sent a new email — check every digit worker_ready The executor is ready to pass the face check again, and BingX sent a new code stale_resent The previous code expired (it works for about 10 minutes), and BingX sent a new one requested Only with action: "risk_proofs": new screenshots have been requested

bingx.code_ask_reason is filled in only when bingx.step = awaiting_code, and it's never requested. If the request opened after your time for the codes had already run out, it's null.

docs.title: Why the slot was cancelled
docs.text:
The slot's close_reason field and the reason of a slot_status event with status CANCELLED. On open and completed slots, and on slots closed before reasons were introduced, it's null.

Value What it means wrong_country The document's country didn't match the order's country, or the account had already been verified in another country before work started blocked The exchange no longer allows verification on this account already_verified The account had already been verified no_check_required Re-verification: the exchange didn't request the check it was ordered for slot_deadline The fulfillment deadline chosen at purchase has passed face_deadline MEXC: the additional face check wasn't passed in time bingx_face_off_failed BingX, second stage: the executor didn't pass the repeat face check in time client_cancel You cancelled it yourself admin_cancel Support cancelled the slot exchange_review_in_flight The exchange is already reviewing another application for this account. If it doesn't pass, the account can be uploaded to a new order exchange_attempts_spent The account has used up today's verification attempts on the exchange. The account can be uploaded to a new order in about a day

docs.title: Deadline kinds
docs.text:
The kind field in the slot's deadlines. Deadlines are sorted by at, earliest first.

Value What it means slot_deadline The fulfillment deadline chosen at purchase budget If the executor doesn't finish, the slot goes back to the pool no later than this moment (executor's time) mexc_hold MEXC: the end of the observation window after KYC mexc_face MEXC: the deadline for the additional face check close_request The slot will be closed at at; the reason is in reason (below) client_cancel When your re-verification cancellation will be checked

close_request and client_cancel disappear from the list once their time has passed. Other deadlines may stay briefly after their at.

docs.title: Why a cancellation is scheduled
docs.text:
The reason field in the slot's deadlines; only for kind: "close_request", null for the others.

Value What it means admin_cancel Support scheduled the cancellation slot_deadline The slot's fulfillment deadline has passed face_deadline The MEXC face check deadline has passed

docs.title: BingX second-stage steps
docs.text:
The bingx.step field. The bingx object is present on a BingX slot from the second stage on; on other slots it's null.

Value What it means requesting_code The platform is asking BingX to email the code awaiting_code Waiting for your code — send it; your time is running checking_code The code is being checked, usually within a minute face_in_progress The code was accepted, and the executor is passing the face check switching_off The face check has passed, and the platform is turning off face login waiting_for_worker The executor's attempt failed; when they're ready, BingX will send a new code under_review The slot is with support (status BINGX_REVIEW) done The second stage is over; the outcome is in face_login or close_reason

While the slot is waiting for a re-upload, step doesn't change, your time is paused, and no code is accepted.

docs.title: BingX second-stage outcome
docs.text:
The reason field of a slot_status event with status COMPLETED on a BingX slot, and the bingx.face_login field.

reason bingx.face_login What it means bingx_face_login_off off KYC has passed, and face login is turned off bingx_face_login_left_on left_on KYC has passed, but face login stayed on — for example, your time for the codes ran out bingx_face_login_unknown unknown Support completed the slot; the platform didn't check whether face login is off

face_login is null while the second stage is under way, and on a cancelled slot. A slot completed before the second stage has neither a bingx object nor a reason in the event.

docs.title: Notices
docs.text:
The notice field of slot_notice and order_notice events.

Value Event What it means bingx_code_accepted slot_notice BingX accepted your code. The code may be needed again later slot_frozen slot_notice The slot came back from the executor into a frozen order: it isn't offered to executors until you renew your subscription or cancel the slot order_frozen order_notice The subscription has ended: the order's untaken slots are frozen; slots in progress will be finished order_unfrozen order_notice The subscription has been renewed: the frozen slots are offered to executors again

docs.title: Balance changes
docs.text:
The balance_event field of the balance event.

Value What it means deposit A top-up has been credited spend A charge: an order, a subscription or a re-verification refund A refund to your balance referral_accrual A referral bonus manual_adjustment A balance adjustment by support legacy_opening An opening balance from the move to the current accounting system; only on long-standing accounts

docs.title: The file can't be read
docs.text:
A 422 response (413 for too_many_items) to an account upload, a re-upload or a bulk re-verification account upload. at is the account number (yours from positions, or the profile's number in the ADS Power file), profile is the profile name, and detail gives details. If there are several problems, issues lists them all, and the response itself repeats the first one.

code What it means parse_too_large The file is too large for one account's cookies (an ADS Power file — over 20 MB) parse_too_many_cookies Cookies from many sites, while only the exchange's cookies are needed parse_cookie_value_too_long Doesn't look like a regular cookies export cookie_jar_too_large Cookies from many sites — the exchange will reject such a request no_platform_cookies The file has no cookies for the exchange you need parse_unrecognized_format Not cookies: a screenshot or text from a page parse_empty_adspower The ADS Power file has no profiles at all too_many_items More than 200 profiles or proxy lines (limit) parse_block_missing_cookie An ADS Power profile has no cookies — it isn't logged in parse_no_proxies No proxy lines at all invalid_proxy The proxy can't be read, or its scheme isn't supported private_proxy A local or internal address, not a proxy parse_not_a_text_file Not a text file parse_encrypted_export A password-protected Cookie-Editor export parse_har_file A recording of network requests (HAR), not cookies parse_broken_json The cookies are damaged: the text is cut off or has extra characters parse_unsupported_cookie_export This cookies format can't be read (for example, a cURL command) parse_multiple_accounts_in_one_file Cookies from several accounts in one file parse_adspower_file An ADS Power export where one account's cookies file is expected — use method=adspower parse_empty_cookies The export is empty parse_wrong_exchange Cookies from a different exchange; detail says which parse_wrong_site Cookies from a different site; detail is the domain parse_not_logged_in The cookies aren't logged in to the account (MEXC, Bybit); detail may name the domain where you are logged in parse_not_an_adspower_file This isn't an ADS Power export; detail: cookies — it's a cookies file, proxies — it's a proxy list parse_export_without_cookies No profile has cookies parse_block_has_two_profiles Two profiles merged into one — the separator line is missing. Export again and don't edit the file parse_unsupported_proxy_type The proxy type in the profile isn't supported: HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS is required parse_proxy_has_spaces The proxy line has extra text or two proxies parse_proxy_no_port The proxy port is missing parse_proxy_non_latin The proxy has non-Latin letters

docs.title: The account failed the check
docs.text:
The error_code field of accounts in GET /orders/{order_id}/upload. The same codes are returned in a 409 response to a proxy change or a re-upload, except that "no proxy" is proxy_missing there, not missing_proxy. A rejected account doesn't go into the slot.

code What it means What to do proxy_auth_rejected The proxy rejected the login or password Check them with your proxy provider proxy_timeout The proxy isn't responding — for example, it isn't paid for or is turned off Check the proxy or send another one proxy_bad_host The proxy address wasn't found Check the address proxy_unreachable Couldn't connect to the proxy Check the port and the type (HTTP or SOCKS5) proxy_broken The proxy doesn't work Send another proxy missing_proxy The account has no proxy (for example, an ADS Power profile without a proxy) Provide a proxy; in ADS Power, add it to the profile and export again exchange_unreachable The proxy works, but the exchange doesn't open through it Use a proxy from a different provider or city session_invalid The exchange doesn't accept these cookies for the account — the login has expired Log in again, export the cookies right away and don't log out session_not_logged_in The cookies aren't logged in to the account (happens on KuCoin) Log in, export the cookies and don't log out cookie_jar_too_large The export has cookies from many sites Export the cookies on the exchange's tab only identity_mismatch This isn't the same account as the one already in the slot Upload the same account duplicate_account_other_slot The account is already in another slot of this order; conflict_slot_id names the slot Use a different account duplicate_account_other_order, duplicate_account The account is already uploaded to another order Use a different account already_verified The account has already passed verification on the exchange Use a different account verification_blocked The exchange no longer allows verification on this account Use a different account verification_attempts_spent The account has run out of verification attempts for today Upload it again in about a day, or use a different one verification_in_review The exchange is already reviewing an application for this account Wait for the outcome, or use a different account exchange_refused_unclear The exchange won't let the verification start, and the reason is unknown Use a different account; if you need this one in particular, contact support exchange_unreadable The exchange didn't respond Upload the account again in a few minutes slot_unavailable While the check was running, the slot was taken by an executor or closed; nothing has changed Retry if needed slot_busy The slot is being checked right now Retry in a minute unknown_error The check didn't complete Retry in a few minutes; if it happens again, contact support

docs.title: Error format
docs.text:
An error is returned with a 4xx or 5xx status and this body:

{"detail": {"code": "price_changed", "price": "13.00", "total": "65.00",
  "message": "The live price is above the one you sent; nothing was charged. See 'price' and 'total'."}}
  • code — a stable code. Decide what to do based on the HTTP status and code.
  • message — an English sentence for logs. It may change — don't parse it.
  • Other fields add details to the code; the tables below list which ones can appear.
  • For an unknown code: 4xx — change the request; 5xx — retry later.
  • A malformed multipart form (a field over 1 MB, too many fields) gets a 400 response where detail is a string without a code.

docs.title: Common errors
docs.text:
Any method can return these. A method's own errors are on its page.

HTTP code What it means and what to do 401 invalid_api_key No key, the header isn't Authorization: Bearer <key>, or there's no such key 401 api_key_revoked The key has been revoked — create a new one 403 api_not_enabled API access is turned off. Your keys are kept and will work again once access is restored. Contact support 403 banned The account is blocked — contact support 403 ip_not_allowed The request IP isn't on the key's list 403 scope_required The key lacks the right named in scope — create a key with that right 404 order_not_found You have no such order. Someone else's order and a nonexistent one get the same response 404 slot_not_found You have no such slot in this order — on any path with a slot, even if the order number is wrong 404 not_found No such method 405 method_not_allowed The method doesn't accept this HTTP verb 411 length_required A form with a file was sent in chunks — Content-Length is required 413 payload_too_large The body is larger than allowed 415 unsupported_media_type A method with files expects multipart/form-data 422 validation_error The request doesn't match the documentation; field shows where the first error is: body.quantity, query.limit, header.Idempotency-Key. A request without a required Idempotency-Key gets the same response 422 invalid_idempotency_key Idempotency-Key isn't in the right format 422 idempotency_key_reused This Idempotency-Key has already been used for a different request — new action, new key 409 idempotency_in_progress A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running — retry in a few seconds with the same key 429 rate_limited The limit is exceeded — wait Retry-After seconds 500 internal_error A platform failure — retry later; if it keeps happening, contact support 503 try_again Nothing was done — retry with the same Idempotency-Key 503 queue_unavailable The platform is busy, nothing was done — retry in a few seconds (after retry_after_seconds, if it's present)

docs.title: Request limits
docs.text:
Counter Limit Methods Read 300 per 60 s Every GET Write 60 per 60 s Every POST, PUT, DELETE Lists 60 per 60 s GET /orders, /slots, /reverify, /transactions, /team Feed 30 per 60 s GET /events Upload 20 per 60 s POST /orders/{order_id}/upload, …/slots/{slot_id}/proxy, …/reupload, …/replace-proxy, …/start-proxy-replace, POST /reverify/batches Money 15 per 60 s POST /orders, POST /subscription, …/cancel, …/cancel-frozen, …/cancel-reverify, POST /reverify/batches/{batch_id}/execute, …/retry Check KYC 60 per 3600 s POST …/check-kyc New BingX code 60 per 60 s POST …/bingx-code/refresh
  • Every counter is kept both per key and per account: a request goes through only if neither is exceeded. Ten keys don't give you ten limits.
  • A request counts against the general counter (read or write) and against its own counter, if it has one: GET /orders counts as one read and one list request.
  • The window is fixed: it starts with the first request in the window. Rejected requests count too.
  • Over the limit, you get 429 rate_limited with a Retry-After header: the seconds until the window ends.
  • After 30 invalid_api_key responses within 60 seconds from one IP, all requests from that IP get 429 rate_limited until the end of the window — even with a valid key.

docs.title: Concurrent operations
docs.text:
The refusal lifts once the operation already running finishes. Only cooldown comes with Retry-After.

What How many Response Uploads being checked — across all orders, together with the bot and the web app 2 per account 429 upload_concurrency_limit, 409 too_many_uploads Checking an upload to one order 1 409 upload_in_progress Exchange calls for your slots: Check KYC, proxy change, re-upload 3 429 client_exchange_busy Checking one slot 1; the next one in 30 s, or 15 s after a failed one 409 check_in_flight, 429 cooldown Purchase 1 409 purchase_in_progress Checking a bulk re-verification batch 1 409 reverify_validate_in_progress Launching a bulk re-verification 1 409 reverify_in_progress

docs.title: Request size
docs.text:
Request Limit The JSON body of any method except those below 64 KB PUT /reverify/batches/{batch_id}/proofs 1 000 000 bytes POST /orders/{order_id}/upload, POST /reverify/batches 34 MB; an ADS Power file up to 20 MB; a cookies file up to 8 MB, all of them together up to 32 MB; the proxies field up to 1 MB; up to 200 accounts POST …/slots/{slot_id}/reupload 22 MB POST /risk-proofs/files 18 MB

A body over 64 KB is accepted only by methods with files, and only as multipart/form-data.

docs.title: Idempotency-Key
docs.text:
The header is required on nine methods: POST /orders, POST /subscription, POST /orders/{order_id}/upload, POST /reverify/batches, POST /reverify/batches/{batch_id}/execute, …/retry, POST /orders/{order_id}/cancel, …/cancel-frozen, POST …/slots/{slot_id}/cancel-reverify.

  • Format: 8–64 characters — Latin letters, digits, -, _. A UUID works.
  • New action — new key. Use the same key only to retry the same request: the method, path, parameters and body, byte for byte. When retrying, send the saved body instead of rebuilding it.
  • Keys are shared across the account: the same Idempotency-Key from two API keys is one request.
  • A successful response is kept for 24 hours. A retry gets that same response with an Idempotent-Replayed: true header; nothing is executed a second time.
  • Errors aren't remembered: after a 4xx or 5xx response, a retry with the same key is executed again.
  • Order and subscription purchases are remembered longer: a retry with the same key won't buy a second time even a day later. So don't use one purchase's key for another purchase.

POST /risk-proofs/files has its own optional X-Upload-Key header (a UUID): a retry with it within 24 hours returns the same screenshot.

docs.title: Get events
docs.text:
GEThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/events

Returns events for your orders, slots and balance that came after the cursor.

Right: read

Parameter Type Required Description cursor string no The cursor from the previous response; without it, the feed starts from now

Response 200:

{
  "events": [
    {"id": "3f9c2a7b1e0d4c58a6b2f1e9d0c7a4b3", "at": "2026-10-30T11:40:02Z", "kind": "slot_action_required",
     "order_id": "8402-9173", "slot_id": "5120-3562", "status": "BINGX_FACE_OFF",
     "balance_event": null, "cash_delta": null, "referral_delta": null,
     "action": "bingx_code", "reason": "first", "notice": null},
    {"id": "a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90", "at": "2026-10-30T11:42:10Z", "kind": "balance",
     "order_id": "8402-9173", "slot_id": null, "status": null,
     "balance_event": "refund", "cash_delta": "8.00", "referral_delta": "0.00",
     "action": null, "reason": null, "notice": null}
  ],
  "cursor": "gAAAAABn…",
  "has_more": false
}
Event field Description id The event ID; use it to filter out duplicates kind Event kind order_id For balance, set only if the balance change relates to your order status For order_status and slot_status — the new status (slot, order); for a request or notice — the status at that moment balance_event balance only: the kind of change cash_delta, referral_delta balance only: the change in the main and referral balance; negative means a charge action slot_action_required only: what to do reason For a request — the request reason; for CANCELLED — why the slot was closed; for COMPLETED on a BingX slot — the second-stage outcome. null on old events notice slot_notice and order_notice only: what the notice is about HTTP code When 410 cursor_expired The cursor is older than 7 days 422 invalid_cursor The cursor wasn't issued by this API

docs.title: Cursor
docs.text:
• The first request has no cursor: you get an empty events list, a fresh cursor and has_more: false. What happened earlier is in the order and slot lists.
  • After that, send the cursor from the latest response. Save it so you can continue from the same place after a restart.
  • has_more: true means only part of the events was returned: request again right away. Such a batch may contain fewer events than usual, or even none.
  • A cursor is valid for 7 days and is renewed by regular polling, even when there are no events.
  • On 410 cursor_expired and 422 invalid_cursor, re-read the lists and start the feed without a cursor.
  • Don't parse or build the cursor yourself.

docs.title: Delivery
docs.text:
Every event is delivered at least once and may be delivered again.

  • Every request also returns the events from the 60 seconds before the previous request, so events recorded with a delay aren't lost. Skip events with an id you've already seen — keeping the ids for 10 minutes is enough.
  • Rarely, after platform maintenance, recent events arrive again under new ids. So read the slot before acting: if it's no longer waiting for anything, do nothing.
  • Within one response, events are sorted by at, but a delayed event may arrive after a newer one. For the current state, read the slot or order.

docs.title: Event kinds
docs.text:
kind When it arrives order_status An order's status changed slot_status A slot's status changed. REUPLOAD_REQUIRED — the slot is waiting for a re-upload; for CANCELLED, the reason is in reason, and the refund arrives as a separate balance event balance A balance change: a top-up, a charge, a refund, a referral bonus, an adjustment slot_action_required The slot is waiting for your action, even if its status didn't change: read the slot and respond according to action slot_notice A notice about a slot without a status change order_notice A notice about an order without a status change
  • A BingX slot was waiting for a code and then needed a re-upload. If only the proxy is replaced, a new slot_action_required arrives with the same reason. After new cookies, the second stage starts over, and the request arrives with a new BingX email.
  • Every order_frozen is later followed by an order_unfrozen if the order is still open when the subscription is renewed. order_unfrozen may also arrive without an order_frozen.

docs.title: Polling loop
docs.text:
1. At startup, get a cursor — GET /events with no parameters — then read GET /slots?attention=true and respond to what the slots are waiting for. The first request with this cursor replays the last 60 seconds, so nothing gets lost in between.
  2. Every 10–30 seconds, call GET /events?cursor=…; if has_more: true, call again right away.
  3. Handle the events with a new id and save the new cursor.
  4. 410 or 422 — go back to step 1. 429 — wait Retry-After and retry with the same cursor. A network failure or 5xx — retry with the same cursor in 10–30 seconds. 401 or 403 — stop: the key is revoked, access is turned off or the IP isn't on the key's list.

docs.title: Getting started
docs.text: With the API, you can buy and publish orders, upload accounts to them and track slots — without the bot or the web app.

docs.title: Access
docs.text: Access is free and enabled on request: contact support at @freidbase. Once it's enabled, a "🔑 API" button appears in the workspace bot @kycportal_bot, and in the web app app.kycportal.org the "API" section (the "Tools" group) shows a "Create key" button.

docs.title: Keys
docs.text:
• A key is the string kp_live_ followed by 43 more characters.
  • You can have up to 10 active keys.
  • Rights are chosen when the key is created and can't be changed later; for a different set, create a new key (rights).
  • A key can be restricted to a list of up to 20 IPv4 or IPv6 addresses and subnets like 203.0.113.0/24. An empty list means any IP. If your server also connects to the internet over IPv6, add its IPv6 address too.

Warning

A key is shown once — when it's created. Save it right away. Anyone who has the key controls the account within the key's rights: if you lose it or suspect a leak, revoke it.

docs.title: Create a key in the bot
docs.text:
1. In your private chat with @kycportal_bot, tap "🔑 API", then "➕ New key".
  2. Send a name for the key — up to 64 characters.
  3. Switch on the rights you need — "▫️ Upload accounts", "▫️ Money" — and tap "Continue".
  4. Send the IP addresses or subnets separated by commas or spaces — or tap "Any IP".
  5. Tap "✅ Create". The key arrives in a separate message; tap it to copy. Save it and tap "✅ I saved it". After 10 minutes, the message deletes itself.

docs.title: Create a key in the web app
docs.text:
1. Open the "API" section and tap "Create key".
  2. Fill in "Name", select the "Rights" you need and, if needed, "Allowed IPs (optional)". Tap "Create key".
  3. Tap "Copy key", then "I saved the key". Once the window is closed, the key can't be shown again.

docs.title: Revoke a key
docs.text:
• In the bot: "🔑 API" → the key's button "🗑 name …1234" → "🗑 Revoke".
  • In the web app: "Revoke" next to the key, then "Revoke" in the confirmation window.

Revoking is final and takes effect from the next request. While API access is turned off, keys aren't shown; to revoke a key during that time, ask support.

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text:
The API base URL is https://app.kycportal.org/api/v1; paths in this documentation are relative to it. Pass the key in the Authorization: Bearer <key> header of every request.

curl https://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/ping \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KP_API_KEY"

Response 200:

{"client_id": 123456789, "scopes": ["read", "upload"]}

client_id is your account number (Telegram ID), and scopes lists the key's rights. If the key isn't accepted, the response is 401 or 403 (codes).

docs.title: Key rights
docs.text:
Right When creating a key What it allows read "Read", every key has it All read requests, the event feed, the top-up address upload "Upload accounts" Uploading and replacing accounts and proxies, publishing, re-uploading, Check KYC, the BingX code, deposit screenshots, accounts and screenshots for a bulk re-verification money "Money" Everything that charges or refunds money: buying orders and subscriptions, launching and retrying a bulk re-verification, cancellations

Rights are independent: you can grant money without upload and vice versa. The right a method needs is stated on its page.

docs.title: General rules
docs.text:
Field types in method descriptions:

Type What it looks like in JSON string "adspower" integer 42 yes/no true or false amount A string with a decimal point, in US dollars: "12.50". Pass amounts as strings in requests too time ISO 8601 in UTC: "2026-10-30T12:00:00Z", sometimes with fractions of a second: "2026-10-30T12:00:00.123456Z" number An order, slot or executor number: "8402-9173" list ["read", "upload"] object {"step": "awaiting_code", …}

"or null" after a type means the field can be null.

  • Requests and responses are JSON. Methods with files take multipart/form-data.
  • Every response field is always present; if there's no value, it's null.
  • New fields and code values are added over time — ignore the ones you don't recognize.
  • Pass other IDs (an event's id, batch_id, a screenshot's id) back exactly as you received them.
  • Durations are integers; the unit is in the field name: …_seconds, min_hours, duration_days.
  • Set the HTTP timeout to at least 120 seconds: methods that reach the exchange through your proxy can take up to a minute and a half to respond.

docs.title: Pagination
docs.text:
GET /orders, GET /slots, GET /reverify and GET /transactions return paginated lists:

Parameter Type Required Description limit integer no From 1 to 100, default 20 offset integer no From 0 to 10 000, default 0 
{"items": [], "total": 57, "offset": 0, "limit": 20}

Newest records come first. For the next page, pass offset + limit; continue while offset is less than total. The members field of GET /team is paginated the same way.

docs.title: Workflow
docs.text:
1. Choose a product and a price: GET /catalog.
  2. Buy an order: POST /orders.
  3. Upload accounts — POST /orders/{order_id}/upload — and poll GET /orders/{order_id}/upload until the check finishes. Upload the rejected accounts again.
  4. Once every slot has an account, publish the order: POST /orders/{order_id}/publish.
  5. Poll the feed GET /events every 10–30 seconds.
  6. On slot_action_required or REUPLOAD_REQUIRED, read the slot and do what waiting_for_client says: BingX code, deposit screenshots or re-upload.

docs.title: Get the catalog
Buy an order
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders

Buys an order and charges the full amount right away: first from the referral balance, then from the main one. The order's slots start out empty — next, upload accounts.

Right: money · Idempotency-Key required

Body field Type Required Description type string yes standard, wholesale or team quantity integer yes From 1 to 100 service_id integer for standard, wholesale A product from GET /catalog expected_price_per_slot amount for standard, wholesale Up to 2 decimal places. If it's below the current price, the request is refused; otherwise the current price is charged exchange string for team bybit, mexc, kucoin or bingx region string for team A code from the catalog's team_regions team_price amount for team Your price per slot: greater than zero, up to 2 decimal places deadline_hours integer no The slot's fulfillment deadline from publishing, 4–72 hours; omit it for no deadline

A team order costs team_price × quantity.

curl -X POST https://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"type": "standard", "service_id": 42, "quantity": 5, "expected_price_per_slot": "12.50", "deadline_hours": 24}'

Response 201:

{"order_id": "8402-9173", "total": "62.50"}

total is how much was charged.

HTTP code When 409 price_changed The price went up, nothing was charged; price and total are the current values 409 insufficient_balance Not enough balance 409 purchase_in_progress Another purchase of yours is in progress; retry in a few seconds 409 service_unavailable The product isn't on sale or is out of stock 403 subscription_required A wholesale or team order without an active subscription 403 team_membership_required A team order, but your team has no active members

docs.title: List re-verification slots
Bulk re-verification
docs.text:
Re-verifications are ordered in batches: accounts of one exchange and one type. The account check and the plan are free; money is charged only at launch.

  1. GET /reverify/meta — what can be ordered and at what price.
  2. POST /reverify/batches — upload accounts with fresh cookies and proxies.
  3. Poll GET /reverify/batches/{batch_id} every few seconds until state becomes done and plan appears.
  4. Only if plan.needs_proofs: true (Risk Removal): upload screenshots to POST /risk-proofs/files and attach them via PUT …/proofs.
  5. Launch POST …/execute with expected_total = plan.total.
  6. Check the outcome in GET …/execution; if retryable: true, fix the cause and call POST …/retry.

A batch lives for 1 hour after the upload; for Risk Removal, every read or write of the screenshots extends it, up to 12 hours after the upload. batch_id is 12 characters of 0-9a-f. The created orders are published automatically and assigned to the executor who did the initial verification; follow them in the feed and in GET /reverify.

docs.title: Get re-verification options
Create a re-verification batch
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/reverify/batches

Uploads accounts to a batch; the check runs in the background. Fresh cookies and proxies are needed — the original order's data isn't used. Up to 120 accounts, and no more than the number of verified accounts you have on the exchange: the extra ones are dropped.

Right: upload · Idempotency-Key required

Form field Type Required Description exchange string yes exchange from GET /reverify/meta verification_type string yes verification_type from GET /reverify/meta method, ads_file, proxies, cookie_files, positions — — Same as for uploading to an order; the whole request is up to 34 MB 
curl -X POST https://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/reverify/batches \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -F method=manual \
  -F exchange=mexc \
  -F verification_type=MEXC_FACE_SECURITY \
  -F "proxies=<proxies.txt" \
  -F cookie_files=@acc1.json \
  -F cookie_files=@acc2.json \
  -F cookie_files=@acc3.json

Response 202:

{"batch_id": "a1b2c3d4e5f6", "state": "queued", "staged": 2, "failures": [{"upload_position": 2, "error_code": "proxy_timeout"}]}

state: "no_valid" — there's nothing to check, and there will be no plan. failures[] — accounts that failed the proxy check; error_code: missing_proxy, proxy_broken, proxy_auth_rejected, proxy_timeout, proxy_bad_host or proxy_unreachable. For Risk Removal, no more than 50 accounts go into the plan.

HTTP code When 422 reverify_invalid_type The exchange has no such type, or you have no verified account on it 422 reverify_type_unavailable The type can't be ordered right now 409 reverify_validate_in_progress Another batch of yours is still being checked — wait for it 422 nothing_to_upload The file has no accounts 503 queue_unavailable The queue is busy, nothing was done — retry in a minute 4xx Upload and file parsing codes Same as for POST …/upload

docs.title: Get a batch and its plan
Get the screenshot draft
Save the screenshot draft
docs.text:
PUThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/reverify/batches/{batch_id}/proofs

Replaces the screenshot draft as a whole: an item not in the request is left without screenshots. If even one item fails validation, nothing is saved.

Right: upload

Body field Type Required Description entries list yes Up to 120 items; the body is up to 1 000 000 bytes entries[].index integer yes index from plan.matched, each only once entries[].deposits list yes Up to 4 screenshots entries[].deposits[].file_id string yes The screenshot's id; a screenshot can be used for one account only entries[].deposits[].source string no Where the deposit came from, up to 64 characters; may be empty while the draft is being filled in 
curl -X PUT https://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/reverify/batches/a1b2c3d4e5f6/proofs \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"entries": [{"index": 0, "deposits": [{"file_id": "0b6c2a7e-1111-4222-8333-444455556666", "source": "Bybit"}]}]}'

Response 200 — same as for GET …/proofs.

HTTP code When 422 reverify_invalid_entry The index isn't from the plan or is repeated 404 proof_file_not_found The screenshot wasn't found, belongs to someone else, has already been sent or is listed twice 422 proof_source_invalid An invalid source 422 reverify_type_unavailable This type has no screenshot step 404 reverify_expired The batch has expired, belongs to someone else or wasn't found

docs.title: Launch the re-verification
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/reverify/batches/{batch_id}/execute

Orders and pays for the plan items — at the plan prices, even if the catalog has changed in the meantime. An insufficient balance doesn't block the launch: items the balance can't cover stop as unpaid.

Right: money · Idempotency-Key required

Body field Type Required Description expected_total amount yes Exactly plan.total include_team yes/no no Order the team items too; default false team_price amount or null with plan.needs_team_price and include_team The price for each unpriced team item, on top of plan.total 
curl -X POST https://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/reverify/batches/a1b2c3d4e5f6/execute \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"expected_total": "4.00"}'

Response 202:

{"state": "queued", "ordered": 1, "skipped_without_proofs": 0}

ordered is how many items the launch will try to order. skipped_without_proofs is the number of Risk Removal items without at least one "screenshot + source" pair; they're skipped and not charged.

HTTP code When 409 plan_total_mismatch expected_total doesn't equal plan.total; nothing was charged — re-read the batch 409 reverify_expired The batch has expired, is finished or wasn't found, or the retry window has closed 409 proofs_missing Risk Removal: there was no PUT …/proofs 422 team_price_required A positive team_price is required 409 reverify_in_progress Another launch of yours is already running 503 queue_unavailable The queue is busy, nothing was done — retry in a minute

docs.title: Retry the remainder
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/reverify/batches/{batch_id}/retry

Launches what's left after the previous launch, with the same decision on team items and the same team_price. The retry window lasts until plan.retry_deadline: 2 hours after the first launch that left items remaining.

Right: money · Idempotency-Key required

Body field Type Required Description expected_total amount yes Again, plan.total from GET /reverify/batches/{batch_id} 
curl -X POST https://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/reverify/batches/a1b2c3d4e5f6/retry \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"expected_total": "4.00"}'

Response 202 — same as for execute. The errors are the same too, except team_price_required; 409 reverify_expired is also returned when there's nothing to retry.

docs.title: Get the launch result
Slot actions
docs.text: The waiting_for_client field of the slot card shows what the slot needs from you (values).

docs.title: Re-upload and proxy
docs.text:
A REUPLOAD_REQUIRED slot is paused: its deadlines are on hold, and the slot isn't cancelled or passed to another executor. The slot card's reupload_scope field says what to send. reupload and replace-proxy check the account on the exchange through the slot's proxy — the response can take up to a minute and a half.

Check errors common to reupload and replace-proxy:

HTTP code When 409 check codes The exchange rejected the account or the proxy, for example session_invalid, proxy_broken, exchange_unreachable 409 exchange_transient The exchange didn't respond, but the proxy works; nothing has changed — retry 409 reupload_scope_changed The slot now needs more — read the slot and send what it asks for 409 check_in_flight Another check is running on the slot — retry in a few seconds 409 upload_in_progress An upload check is running on the order 429 client_exchange_busy 3 exchange calls for your slots are already running (limit); no Retry-After 504 proxy_probe_timeout The exchange didn't respond through this proxy in time 502 upload_check_failed A platform failure — retry later

docs.title: Re-upload an account
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/{order_id}/slots/{slot_id}/reupload

Sends fresh cookies (and, if needed, a new proxy) to a slot with reupload_scope session or full. One account only — the one that was in the slot; the whole request is up to 22 MB.

Right: upload

Form field Type Required Description method string yes adspower or manual ads_file file with adspower An ADS Power export with one profile, up to 20 MB; for full, with a proxy cookie_files file with manual A cookies file, up to 8 MB; only the first one is read proxies string with full and manual One proxy line replace_proxy yes/no no true with session — replace the proxy too (the upload is handled as full) 
curl -X POST https://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/8402-9173/slots/5120-3564/reupload \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KP_API_KEY" \
  -F method=manual \
  -F "proxies=203.0.113.21:8000:login5:pass5" \
  -F cookie_files=@fresh.json

Response 200:

{"status": "ok"}

ok — the slot carries on from where it stopped. proxy_broken or proxy_missing — the cookies were accepted, but the saved proxy doesn't work either: the slot now asks for full.

HTTP code When 409 reupload_not_allowed The slot isn't waiting for a re-upload 409 use_replace_proxy The slot is waiting only for a proxy — send it to replace-proxy 409 reupload_identity_mismatch The cookies are from a different account 409 reupload_identity_unavailable This slot can't be updated — contact support 422 reupload_single_account The ADS Power export has more than one profile 422 proxy_missing No proxy was passed for full 422 export_proxy_missing For full: the ADS Power profile has no proxy 422 parse_error The ADS Power export has no account 422 missing_file, invalid_method No file for the chosen method, or an invalid method 422 parsing codes The cookies or proxy can't be read 413 file_too_large The request is over 22 MB, or a file is over its limit

docs.title: Replace the proxy
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/{order_id}/slots/{slot_id}/replace-proxy

Sends a new proxy to a slot with reupload_scope: "proxy". The saved cookies are re-checked through the new proxy.

Right: upload

Body field Type Required Description proxy string yes A proxy line, up to 512 characters 
curl -X POST https://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/8402-9173/slots/5120-3564/replace-proxy \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"proxy": "203.0.113.20:8000:login4:pass4"}'

Response 200:

{"status": "ok"}

ok — the slot carries on from where it stopped. session_invalid or cookie_jar_too_large — the proxy was saved, but the cookies don't work either: the slot now asks for full; send a reupload.

HTTP code When 409 proxy_replace_not_allowed The slot isn't waiting for a new proxy 422 parsing codes The proxy line can't be read: invalid_proxy, private_proxy, parse_proxy_*

docs.title: Pause a slot to replace its proxy
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/{order_id}/slots/{slot_id}/start-proxy-replace

Pauses the slot until a new proxy arrives; use it when the proxy works but the exchange doesn't open through it (check-kyc returned 409 exchange_unreachable). The slot becomes REUPLOAD_REQUIRED with reupload_scope: "proxy" — send the proxy to replace-proxy. Available for FREE slots in a published order and for IN_PROGRESS and VERIFICATION_FAILED slots.

Right: upload

Response 200:

{"status": "ok"}
HTTP code When 409 reupload_required The slot is already waiting for a re-upload 409 slot_no_session The slot has no account 409 edit_not_allowed The slot is in a different status or the order isn't published — before publishing, use POST …/proxy

docs.title: Check the verification status
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/{order_id}/slots/{slot_id}/check-kyc

Asks the exchange for the slot's verification status; if the exchange confirms success, the slot counts as completed. The check_kyc_available field of the slot card shows whether a check is available right now. The response can take up to a minute and a half.

Right: upload

Response 200:

{"action": "pending", "status": "pending", "order_done": false, "verification_type": "INITIAL_KYC"}

action is what the check did with the slot:

  • result_only — no executor has the slot yet: the result is only reported, and the slot doesn't change;
  • stale — the slot changed during the check: read it again;
  • reupload_required — the proxy or the login doesn't work: the slot is paused and waiting for a re-upload; status is proxy_broken, proxy_missing, session_invalid or cookie_jar_too_large;
  • other values (passed_completed, mexc_hold_started, wrong_country_cancelled, blocked_cancelled and others) — the outcome for a slot held by an executor; status explains it.

order_done: true means this check completed the whole order. verification_type is what was checked, for example MEXC_FACE_SECURITY.

status What it means passed The verification has passed mexc_hold MEXC: the verification has passed, and the observation period has started bingx_face_off_started BingX: KYC has passed, and the second stage has started — wait for a code request bingx_review_held BingX: KYC has passed, support will review the slot; nothing is needed from you risk_face_passed Risk Removal: the face check has passed, the appeal comes next wrong_country Passed with a country other than the order's. With action: "wrong_country_cancelled", the slot is cancelled and the money refunded pending The exchange is reviewing the verification available No application yet; for a re-verification — no check is required right now failed The attempt was rejected; another one is possible face_not_submitted The face check is open but not passed yet blocked The exchange doesn't allow verification on the account. With action: "blocked_cancelled", the slot is cancelled and the money refunded; for a re-verification, support decides already_verified With result_only: the account had been verified before the upload stale The slot changed during the check unknown The exchange's answer wasn't recognized HTTP code When 409 slot_no_session The slot has no account 409 proxy_missing The slot has no proxy 409 reupload_required The slot is waiting for a re-upload 409 no_link_yet The executor has taken the slot but hasn't started the verification yet 409 check_not_available A check isn't available in this status; status is the slot status 409 check_in_flight Another check is running on the slot — retry in a few seconds 429 cooldown The slot was checked less than 30 seconds ago (15 after a failed check); seconds and Retry-After say how long to wait 429 client_exchange_busy 3 exchange calls for your slots are already running (limit); no Retry-After 409 exchange_transient The exchange didn't respond, but the proxy works; nothing has changed — retry 409 exchange_unreachable The proxy works, but the exchange doesn't open through it — replace the proxy 409 proxy_broken, session_invalid, cookie_jar_too_large The account data doesn't work, but the slot can't be paused — for example, it isn't published or is already closed 409, 502 status_check_failed The status couldn't be read — retry later

docs.title: BingX code
docs.text:
At the BingX second stage (a BINGX_FACE_OFF slot), you need the code from the email BingX sends to the account's mailbox. You have 60 minutes for the codes per slot; the clock runs only while bingx.client_clock_running: true. When time runs out, the slot completes with face login left on, and the money isn't refunded (outcomes).

  1. Wait for a slot_action_required event with action: "bingx_code"; reason says why the code is requested (values).
  2. Read the slot: if bingx.step: "awaiting_code", take the code from the latest email received no earlier than bingx.code_sent_at.
  3. If bingx.fresh_code_available: true (the email is more than 10 minutes old), call refresh. You can skip this step: if the code has expired, the platform requests a new email itself.
  4. Send the code to bingx-code.
  5. Wait for the result in the feed: slot_notice with notice: "bingx_code_accepted" — the code was accepted; a new request with reason: "wrong_code" — send the code from the latest email again.

docs.title: Send the BingX code
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/{order_id}/slots/{slot_id}/bingx-code

Passes on the code from the BingX email. One code is accepted per code request — the first one, wherever it's sent from: the bot, the web app or the API.

Right: upload

Body field Type Required Description code string yes Up to 32 characters; 4 to 8 digits once spaces are removed 
curl -X POST https://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/8402-9173/slots/5120-3562/bingx-code \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"code": "123 456"}'

Response 200:

{"status": "accepted"}

accepted means the code was taken and sent to BingX, not "the code worked". The outcome arrives in the feed. The API never returns the code.

HTTP code When 409 not_open The slot isn't waiting for a code right now: it hasn't been requested yet, the code has already been taken, the slot is waiting for a re-upload or is closed, or it isn't the BingX second stage 422 bad_format Not 4–8 digits once spaces are removed; nothing has changed

docs.title: Request a new BingX code
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/{order_id}/slots/{slot_id}/bingx-code/refresh

Checks whether the code in the latest email is still valid and, if needed, asks BingX to send a new one.

Right: upload

Response 200:

{"status": "resent"}

still_fresh — the code is less than 10 minutes old; send it. resent — BingX will send a new email, and a request with reason: "stale_resent" will arrive in the feed.

HTTP code When 409 not_open No code is expected right now, or your 60 minutes are over

docs.title: Screenshots for Risk Removal
docs.text: When new deposit screenshots are requested for a Risk Removal slot, a slot_action_required event with action: "risk_proofs" arrives. Upload each screenshot to POST /risk-proofs/files, then send the set to POST …/risk-proofs. For what the screenshot must show, see Risk Removal.

docs.title: Upload a deposit screenshot
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/risk-proofs/files

Uploads one deposit screenshot. An unsent screenshot can be used for 23 hours. Optional X-Upload-Key header (a UUID): a retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the same id.

Right: upload

Form field Type Required Description file file yes JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC (detected by content); 10 KB – 18 MB; each side 300–12 000 pixels 
curl -X POST https://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/risk-proofs/files \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KP_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Upload-Key: 6f1d3c1e-0000-4000-8000-000000000001" \
  -F file=@deposit-1.png

Response 201:

{"id": "0b6c2a7e-1111-4222-8333-444455556666", "size_bytes": 184321, "mime": "image/png"}
HTTP code When 422 proof_not_an_image Not a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, or there's no file part 413 proof_too_large Larger than 18 MB 422 proof_too_small Smaller than 10 KB, or the short side is under 300 pixels 422 proof_dimensions_absurd A side is larger than 12 000 pixels 429 proof_quota_exceeded 250 screenshots or 500 MB within 24 hours of the first upload (deleted ones count too), or already 120 unsent ones; retry_after_seconds 409 proofs_upload_in_progress The first attempt with this X-Upload-Key is still being saved; retry_after_seconds: 3 503 proofs_storage_busy The storage is busy; retry_after_seconds: 5 503 proofs_storage_unavailable The storage is unavailable — retry later

docs.title: Delete a screenshot
docs.text:
DELETEhttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/risk-proofs/files/{file_id}

Deletes your own unsent screenshot.

Right: upload

Response 204 with no body.

HTTP code When 404 proof_file_not_found The screenshot wasn't found, belongs to someone else or has already been sent

docs.title: Submit Risk Removal screenshots
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/{order_id}/slots/{slot_id}/risk-proofs

Sends new screenshots for a Risk Removal slot when they've been requested. The set fully replaces the slot's previous screenshots; it's free of charge.

Right: upload

Body field Type Required Description deposits list yes From 1 to 4 screenshots deposits[].file_id string yes id from POST /risk-proofs/files deposits[].source string yes Where the deposit came from, up to 64 characters; goes into the appeal as is 
curl -X POST https://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/2210-4471/slots/3307-1186/risk-proofs \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"deposits": [{"file_id": "0b6c2a7e-1111-4222-8333-444455556666", "source": "Bybit"},
                   {"file_id": "9d4e1f20-2222-4333-8444-555566667777", "source": "Trust Wallet"}]}'

Response 200:

{"slot_id": "3307-1186", "status": "RISK_REJECTED", "count": 2}

status is the slot status, and count is how many screenshots the slot now has. After sending, risk_proofs disappears from waiting_for_client.

HTTP code When 404 proof_file_not_found The screenshot wasn't found, belongs to someone else, has already been sent or is older than 23 hours 422 proof_source_invalid An empty source 409 risk_proofs_not_requested No new screenshots were requested for the slot, or the slot is closed 409 risk_proofs_invalid The set was rejected 404 slot_not_found Also returned for a slot that isn't Risk Removal

docs.title: Upload accounts
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/{order_id}/upload

Uploads accounts to the order's empty slots and queues them for a background check. Available until the order is published (PAID, SESSION_UPLOADED).

Right: upload · Idempotency-Key required

Form field Type Required Description method string yes adspower or manual ads_file file with adspower An ADS Power .txt export: up to 20 MB, up to 200 profiles proxies string with manual Proxies, one per line, in the order of the files; up to 1 MB cookie_files file, repeated with manual One cookies file per account: up to 8 MB, up to 32 MB in total positions string no With manual: your account numbers, comma-separated (1,3), for at and upload_position replace_all yes/no no true — clear all untaken slots and fill them from the file replace_slot_id number no Replace the account in one untaken slot; if the new one is rejected, the old one stays

The body is multipart/form-data with a Content-Length header: up to 34 MB in total and no more than 200 accounts. The format is below.

curl -X POST https://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/8402-9173/upload \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -F method=manual \
  -F "proxies=<proxies.txt" \
  -F cookie_files=@acc1.json \
  -F cookie_files=@acc2.json

For ADS Power: -F method=adspower -F ads_file=@export.txt.

Response 200:

{"state": "queued", "staged_slot_ids": ["5120-3562", "5120-3563"]}

staged_slot_ids are the slots the accounts went into, in file order. The check result is in GET /orders/{order_id}/upload.

HTTP code When 409 upload_not_allowed The order is already published 409 upload_in_progress The previous upload to this order is still being checked 429 upload_concurrency_limit You already have 2 uploads being checked, counting the bot and the web app; limit, no Retry-After 409 too_many_uploads The same limit, hit by concurrent requests 409 nothing_to_upload The order has no empty slot 422 nothing_to_upload The file has no accounts 409 nothing_to_replace The slot from replace_slot_id is already taken, or the order is published 409 edit_not_allowed The slot from replace_slot_id can't be changed 404 order_not_found The slot from replace_slot_id isn't in the order 409 replace_all_reverify replace_all on a re-verification order 409 replace_account_reverify replace_slot_id on a re-verification order 422 parsing codes The file, cookies or proxy can't be read; at is the account number, issues lists all the problems 422 missing_file No file or proxies for the chosen method 422 invalid_method method is neither adspower nor manual 422 proxy_count_mismatch The number of proxy lines doesn't match the number of cookies files 422 empty_file An empty file; kind says which 413 upload_too_large The request is over 34 MB, or the cookies together are over 32 MB; limit 413 file_too_large A file is over its limit; kind says which 413 too_many_items More than 200 accounts; limit 411 length_required No Content-Length (a chunked body) 415 unsupported_media_type The body is over 64 KB but isn't multipart/form-data 400 — A malformed form (a field over 1 MB, too many fields); detail holds text instead of a code 503 queue_unavailable The platform is busy, nothing was done; retry after retry_after_seconds or in a few seconds

docs.title: Get the upload status
docs.text:
GEThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/{order_id}/upload

Progress and result of the latest upload check. Poll every 3–5 seconds until state becomes done or failed.

Right: read

Response 200:

{
  "state": "done",
  "done": 2,
  "total": 2,
  "ok": 1,
  "all_filled": false,
  "slots": [
    {"slot_id": "5120-3562", "ok": true, "account_identity": "user1@example.com", "error_code": null,
     "conflict_slot_id": null, "country": "UA", "ip": "203.0.113.10", "upload_position": 1, "adspower_profile_name": null},
    {"slot_id": "5120-3563", "ok": false, "account_identity": null, "error_code": "proxy_timeout",
     "conflict_slot_id": null, "country": null, "ip": null, "upload_position": 2, "adspower_profile_name": null}
  ],
  "error": null,
  "deadline_at": null,
  "ignored": 0,
  "cleared": false
}
Field Description state idle — no checks, or the outcome is more than an hour old; queued, running, done, failed done, total, ok Checked / total / accepted all_filled true — every slot in the order has an account, and the order can be published slots[].account_identity The account the exchange found slots[].error_code Why the account was rejected; null — accepted slots[].conflict_slot_id With duplicate_account_other_slot — the slot in this order that has the same account slots[].country, slots[].ip The proxy's exit country (ISO-2) and IP slots[].upload_position The account number: from positions, or its position in the request, from 1 error Why a failed check stopped: timeout, cancelled, probe, payload or requeue deadline_at While the check is running: the check won't run past this time ignored Accounts beyond the free slots; they aren't saved cleared An upload with replace_all has already cleared the slots

If failed, the accepted accounts are kept — send the rest again.

docs.title: Change a proxy before publishing
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/{order_id}/slots/{slot_id}/proxy

Changes the proxy of an uploaded slot that hasn't been taken yet, before publishing; the saved account is re-checked through the new proxy. The response can take up to 90 seconds.

Right: upload

Body field Type Required Description proxy string yes The new proxy, up to 512 characters 
curl -X POST https://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/8402-9173/slots/5120-3563/proxy \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"proxy": "203.0.113.12:8000:login3:pass3"}'

Response 200:

{"status": "ok"}
HTTP code When 409 edit_not_allowed The order is published, the slot is taken, or it has no account 422 invalid_proxy, private_proxy, parse_proxy_has_spaces, parse_proxy_no_port, parse_proxy_non_latin The proxy can't be read (codes) 409 check codes The account failed the check through the new proxy, for example proxy_broken, session_invalid 409 reupload_identity_mismatch The exchange showed a different account from the one in the slot 409 reupload_identity_unavailable The slot's account is unknown; contact support 409 check_in_flight The slot is being checked right now; retry later 409 upload_in_progress An upload to this order is in progress 429 client_exchange_busy 3 checks of your accounts are already running at once; limit 504 proxy_probe_timeout The exchange didn't respond through the proxy in time 502 upload_check_failed The account couldn't be checked; retry later

docs.title: Publish an order
docs.text:
POSThttps://app.kycportal.org/api/v1/orders/{order_id}/publish

Publishes the order: the slots go to executors, the order moves to IN_PROGRESS, and the fulfillment deadline starts running. Every slot must have an account and a proxy. If the order has freezes_on_publish: true, the slots freeze right away until the subscription is renewed.

Right: upload

Response 200:

{"status": "published"}
HTTP code When 409 publish_not_ready The order isn't SESSION_UPLOADED: it has empty slots or is already published, including by a previous request 409 publish_proxy_required The slots listed in slots have no proxy 409 publish_session_required The slots listed in slots have no account 409 publish_in_bot A re-verification order — it's published automatically

docs.title: Upload format
docs.text:
• adspower — one unedited ADS Power export: one profile fills one slot, and the proxy is taken from the profile.
  • manual — proxies holds one proxy per line, cookie_files one file per account: the first line goes to the first file. Cookies are sent only as file parts, not as a text field.
  • Cookie and proxy formats are the same as in Uploading accounts; {"cookies": [...]} (Playwright) and a {"name": "value"} object are also accepted. Only the cookies of the order's exchange are taken from the file.
  • A rejected account doesn't go into the slot. Send only the rejected ones — in a new request with a new Idempotency-Key.

docs.title: Balance and top-ups
docs.text: All purchases are paid from your balance in US dollars. The main balance holds your top-ups and can't be withdrawn. The referral balance holds bonuses for people you've invited (withdrawal); it's spent first when you pay.

docs.title: Topping up
docs.text:
1. Open the top-up screen: "👤 Profile" → "💳 Top up balance" in the shop bot, "💵 Balance (…$)" → "💳 Top up balance" in the workspace bot, or "Balance" in the web app.
  2. Choose a network: BEP20 (BSC), Polygon or Arbitrum One.
  3. Copy the address from the screen before every transfer: the address may change.
  4. Send USDT or USDC, at least 1. A smaller amount isn't credited.
  5. Wait for the "✅ Credited … to your balance" notification. 1 USDT or USDC = $1.
Network Confirmations BEP20 (BSC) 8 Polygon 30 Arbitrum One 20

Warning

A different token or a different network means the money is lost for good. Double-check the token, network and address.

Notifications go to the bot where you last opened the address; if that was the web app, to the workspace bot. Turn them off in the web app: "Settings" → "Notifications" → "Deposits".

docs.title: If your deposit hasn't arrived
docs.text:
1. Check the token, network and amount.
  2. Find the deposit in the web app: "Balance" → "History". It appears there even before it's credited.
  3. If everything is correct but the money hasn't been credited, contact @freidbase and include the transaction hash (TxID).

The full transaction history is in the web app, in the "Transactions" section. Your balance and top-up address are also available in the API.

docs.title: Cancellations and refunds
docs.text:
A refund is always the full price of the slot — to your platform balance, split between the main and referral balance in the same proportion as the payment. Subscription payments aren't refunded.

The main rule. If a verification link has already been issued to an executor, the platform checks the exchange first: passed — no refund; not passed — the money is refunded; the exchange is still reviewing or the answer is unclear — the slot waits for its answer or a manual review. If no link was issued, the money is refunded right away.

You can cancel an unpublished order, frozen slots and a re-verification yourself. A published initial verification slot is either fulfilled or closed with an automatic refund.

docs.title: Unpublished order
docs.text: On the order card: "🗑 Cancel order" → "✅ Yes, cancel the order" (in the web app, "Cancel order · refund $…" → "Yes, cancel the order"). The full amount goes back to your balance right away.

docs.title: Frozen slots
docs.text: On the order card: "Cancel frozen" → "Yes, cancel". The card shows in advance how much comes back right away; a slot waiting for a data update is checked after the re-upload. Cancelled slots don't come back when you renew your subscription.

docs.title: Re-verification
docs.text:
On the slot card: "❌ Cancel re-verification" → "✅ Yes, cancel" (in the web app, "Cancel re-verification" → "Confirm cancel"). Cancelling is available 24 hours after the slot went to the executor (if it never did, after the order was placed); the clock is paused while the exchange is reviewing the verification or the slot is waiting for data. In a team order — right away, if the executor has left the team and isn't working on the slot.

After you confirm, the main rule applies; if a link was issued, the exchange is checked 10 minutes later. If the bot asks you to update the proxy or cookies, the cancellation waits for the re-upload; if it says the cancel request was dropped, send it again after the update.

You can't cancel it yourself while the slot is waiting for a data update, or for Risk Removal once the face check has passed (Risk Removal: cancellation).

docs.title: BingX: second stage
docs.text:
What happens to your money at the second stage, after KYC is confirmed:

  • face login is turned off, or your hour for the codes ran out — the slot is completed, no refund;
  • the executor didn't pass the face check within their time — the platform checks BingX; not passed — a full refund;
  • the slot is under support review — support will complete or cancel it and decide whether to refund.

docs.title: Automatic refunds
docs.text:
The platform closes an initial verification slot with a full refund on its own:

Outcome on the slot card When ⌛ Deadline expired The fulfillment deadline has passed, and the exchange didn't confirm the verification; on MEXC — the face check wasn't passed within 12 hours (observation period); on BingX — see second stage 🚫 Wrong country verified The exchange confirmed the verification with a different country 🚫 KYC no longer available The exchange closed verification for the account ⚠️ Already verified before No link had been issued yet ⚠️ Cancelled — the exchange won't verify this account … Work hadn't started, and the exchange won't let it begin: a block, a different country, the daily attempt limit or a check already in progress

For re-verifications, see How a re-verification ends. If support cancelled the slot, support decides on the refund.

docs.title: Where to see a refund
docs.text: In the bot notification ("💵 …$ has been returned to your balance"), on the order card ("💸 Refunded to your balance: $…") and in the web app: "Transactions" → "Refunds".

docs.title: Getting started
docs.text: Your Telegram account is your account on the platform. Open the shop bot @kyctrade_bot or the workspace bot @kycportal_bot, send /start and choose a language: Russian, Ukrainian or English.

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text:
1. Top up your balance in USDT or USDC — Balance and top-ups.
  2. Buy a verification: exchange, country, quantity and, optionally, a deadline — Orders.
  3. Upload cookies and a proxy for each slot — Uploading accounts.
  4. Publish the order — Publishing.
  5. Watch for notifications — Order execution and deadlines. ⚠️ on the "📋 My orders" button means an order is waiting for your action, such as a re-upload or the code from the BingX email.

docs.title: Settings
docs.text:
"⚙️ Settings" in the workspace bot or "Settings" in the web app:

  • "🌐 Language" — shared by the bots and the web app; in the shop bot, it's under "👤 Profile".
  • "⏱ Worker's time" — how many hours a team member gets per slot, 4 by default — details.
