docs.title: Order execution and deadlines
docs.text: Once the order is published, a slot waits for an executor, the executor completes the verification, the exchange reviews it, and the slot is completed. The executor retries a rejected attempt on their own. If they run out of time, the slot passes to another executor, and your deadline carries on from where it was (Executor's time).

docs.title: Slot statuses
docs.text:
Status What it means 📥 Waiting for upload No account has been uploaded 📤 Account uploaded The account is accepted; the order still has empty slots 📤 Ready to publish All slots are filled — publish the order 🕓 Awaiting executor The slot is waiting for an executor 🔄 In progress The executor is completing the verification or, on MEXC, a face check (in the web app, "Face check") ⏳ Under review (in the web app, "Verifying") The exchange is reviewing the verification; deadlines are paused 🔄 Attempt failed — the worker is retrying The exchange rejected the attempt ⚠️ Data update required (in the web app, "Resubmit required") The slot is paused — update the data 📸 Waiting for face check MEXC: observation period 📸 KYC passed · turning off face login BingX: second stage — send the code when the bot asks 🔎 KYC passed · under support review BingX: support is reviewing the slot ✔️ Completed The verification has passed 🚫 Cancelled The slot is closed; the reason and refund are on the card

A frozen slot has "🧊 This slot is waiting for renewal…" above its card; in the web app, its status is "Frozen". Risk Removal has its own statuses — Risk Removal on MEXC.

docs.title: Fulfillment deadline
docs.text:
You choose the deadline when you buy — options. Re-verifications and Risk Removal have no deadline.

  • The deadline runs from the moment the order is published and doesn't restart when the slot passes to another executor.
  • While the exchange is reviewing the verification, or the slot is waiting for your data or is frozen, the deadline is paused and then extended by the length of the pause.
  • On MEXC and BingX, once KYC is confirmed, the deadline no longer applies: from then on, the MEXC observation period and the second stage on BingX apply.

The deadline is shown on the slot card: "⏳ Slot deadline: …"; in the web app, "Verification deadline".

When the deadline passes:

  • no verification link has been issued to an executor yet — the slot is cancelled right away, and the money returns to your balance;
  • a link has been issued — 10 minutes later, the platform checks the exchange. The verification has passed — the slot is completed; it hasn't — the slot is cancelled with a refund ("⌛ Deadline expired"). Until the exchange answers, the slot isn't cancelled; if the check needs fresh data, the platform asks you to update it.

docs.title: Checking the status
docs.text:
"🔍 Check status" on the slot card ("Check status" in the web app) asks the exchange for the verification status. If the exchange confirms success, the slot counts as completed. You can check again after 30 seconds.

If the check finds a problem: the login has expired or the proxy doesn't respond — the slot asks for a re-upload; the proxy works, but the exchange doesn't open through it — replace the proxy.

docs.title: MEXC observation period
docs.text:
MEXC often asks for a repeat face check right after verification, so the slot isn't completed right away:

  1. For 30 minutes, the slot shows "📸 Waiting for face check". If the exchange doesn't request a face check, the slot completes on its own.
  2. If it does, the executor has 12 hours to pass it. It costs you nothing.
  3. If the executor doesn't make it, the platform checks the exchange: the face check has passed — the slot is completed; it hasn't — the slot is cancelled with a refund.

From the moment KYC is confirmed, the order deadline and the executor's time no longer apply. Nothing is needed from you.

docs.title: Second stage on BingX
docs.text: Once BingX has confirmed KYC, the system turns off face login on the account. This requires the code BingX emails to the account and one more face check, which the same executor passes. The slot's status is "📸 KYC passed · turning off face login"; the order deadline no longer applies, and the slot doesn't pass to another executor. If face login is already off, no code is needed.

docs.title: How to send the code
docs.text:
1. Wait for the bot's message "KYC passed. One step left: turning off face login…" with an "🔢 Enter code" button (in the web app, the slot gets a "code needed" tag).
  2. Find the latest BingX email with the code in the account's mailbox.
  3. Send the code in one of these places:
    • in the workspace bot @kycportal_bot — "🔢 Enter code", then the code in one message, digits only;
    • in the web app — on the slot page, "Enter code", the "Code from the latest BingX email" field, "Send" (details);
    • through the API — BingX code.
  4. The bot replies "Code accepted". After that, the executor passes the face check — nothing is needed from you.

The code works for about 10 minutes. If it has expired, tap "🔢 Enter code" again: the system asks BingX for a new email itself. If it's rejected, check it against the latest email and send it again; after the third wrong code, BingX sends a new email. If the executor needs another face check, the bot asks for a new code.

docs.title: Time
docs.text:
Whose How much When it runs Yours — for the codes 1 hour for the whole slot Only while the system is waiting for your code; doesn't restart with a new code The executor's — for the face check 2 hours Only on their turn

While the slot is waiting for a re-upload, both clocks are paused. The time left is shown on the slot card and in every request for a code. Your clock runs from the moment the email is sent, even if the bot's message didn't reach you: don't block the workspace bot, and keep an eye on the account's mailbox.

docs.title: How the second stage ends
docs.text:
Outcome Money The code is accepted, face login is off The slot is completed Your hour ran out: "The time to send the codes (1 hour) ran out…" The slot is completed — KYC has passed, but face login stayed on. The money isn't refunded The executor didn't pass the face check within 2 hours The platform checks BingX: passed — the slot is completed; not passed — it's cancelled, and the full price goes back to your balance "🔎 KYC passed · under support review" — the system can't complete the slot on its own (for example, BingX also asks for a Google Authenticator code or a phone code) Support will complete or cancel the slot; whether the money is refunded on cancellation is up to support

There are no re-verifications for BingX.

docs.title: Frozen slots
docs.text:
When your subscription ends, slots of published wholesale and team orders that no executor holds right now are frozen: they aren't offered to executors until you renew.

  • Slots already in progress are finished as usual; if such a slot goes back to the queue, it freezes too.
  • A frozen slot's deadline is paused; after renewal, it's extended by the time the slot spent frozen.
  • Frozen slots aren't cancelled on their own.

Renew the subscription, and the slots go to executors again. Or tap "Cancel frozen" on the order card — how the refund works. Standard orders and re-verifications aren't frozen.

docs.title: Orders
docs.text: An order is a single purchase: an exchange, a country and a number of verifications. A slot is one account in an order; slots are fulfilled independently. An order and a slot each have a number like 1234-5678 — use it to search for an order and when you contact support.

docs.title: Order types
docs.text: Type Price Fulfilled by Requirement Where to buy Standard Retail Platform executors from the order's country — Shop bot, web app Wholesale Discounted Platform executors from the order's country Subscription Workspace bot, web app Team You set it; the full amount goes to the executor Only your team Subscription and an active team member Workspace bot, web app Re-verification See Re-verifications Whoever did the first verification The account was verified through the platform Workspace bot, web app

docs.title: How to buy
docs.text:
1. Open the catalog: in the shop bot @kyctrade_bot — "🛍 Catalog"; in the workspace bot @kycportal_bot — "➕ New order" → "Wholesale" or "For my team"; in the web app — "Create order".
  2. Choose the exchange and country and, for a team order, the price per slot.
  3. Enter the quantity (in the bot, after "🛒 Buy"): no more than 100 per order.
  4. Optionally choose a deadline and confirm: "✅ Confirm" in the bot, "Pay" in the web app. The amount is deducted from your balance right away.

  5. Tap "📤 Upload accounts" and upload the accounts.

  6. "Insufficient balance." — top up your balance and try again.

  7. The price has changed — confirm the new amount.
  8. "⛔️ Currently out of stock" — tap "🔔 Notify when available".
  9. Less than 24 hours left on your subscription — you'll see a warning, but you can still buy; for what happens to the slots, see When your subscription ends.

On BingX, after KYC you'll need to forward the code from the BingX email — Second stage on BingX.

docs.title: Slot deadline
docs.text:
When you buy a standard, wholesale or team order, you can set a deadline by which each slot must pass verification: "No deadline", "4 h", "8 h", "12 h", "24 h", "48 h" or "72 h"; in the web app, "Other…" allows any whole number of hours from 4 to 72.

The deadline is the same for all slots in the order, doesn't affect the price and can't be changed after purchase. If verification hasn't passed by the deadline, the slot is cancelled and the money returns to your balance. For how the deadline runs, see Fulfillment deadline.

docs.title: Publishing
docs.text:
Executors can't see an order until you publish it.

  1. Upload cookies and a proxy to every slot — you can't publish part of an order. The order moves to "📤 Ready to publish".
  2. Tap "✅ Publish now" → "🚀 Confirm & publish" (in the web app, "Publish order" → "Publish").

Before publishing, you can replace a slot's account or cancel the order with a full refund. After publishing, a slot's data changes only when the platform asks for it or the exchange doesn't open through your proxy — Re-uploading.

Without a subscription, a wholesale or team order can still be published, but its slots are frozen right away until you renew.

docs.title: Where to see your orders
docs.text:
In the workspace bot — "📋 My orders", with search by order number, slot number or the account's full email; ⚠️ on an order's line means it's waiting for your action. In the web app — "Orders" and "Slots" (Web app).

Order status: "📥 Waiting for account upload" → "📤 Ready to publish" → "🔄 In progress" → "✔️ Completed", "✔️ Partially completed" (some slots cancelled) or "🚫 Cancelled" (none fulfilled). The "💸 Refunded to your balance: $…" line on the order card shows how much has come back for the order. For slot statuses, see Slot statuses.

docs.title: Platform overview
docs.text:
KYC Portal verifies (KYC) your accounts on crypto exchanges. You buy a verification for the exchange and country you need and hand over the account's cookies and proxy. An executor from that country passes the identity check through a link created inside the account; they never get the login details.

Exchanges: Bybit, MEXC, KuCoin, BingX. Countries and prices are in the catalog.

On MEXC and BingX, there's a second stage after KYC — MEXC, BingX. On BingX, it requires you to forward the code from the BingX email.

docs.title: Where to work
docs.text:
Where What for Shop bot @kyctrade_bot Buying at standard prices, top-ups, referral link Workspace bot @kycportal_bot Uploading accounts, order progress, wholesale and team orders, re-verifications, team, subscription, BingX code Web app Everything in the workspace bot, plus the catalog, full transaction history, analytics and choosing executors API The same actions with a key; connected free of charge through support

Your balance, orders and language are shared by the bots and the web app.

docs.title: Terms
docs.text:
• Slot — one account in an order, with its own status.
  • Executor ("Sellers" in the interface) — the person who passes the identity check for your slot.
  • Re-verification — a repeat check of an account verified through the platform.

docs.title: Referral program
docs.text:
Your referral balance is credited with:

  • up to 10% of the price of every verification your referral buys at the standard price, once it passes;
  • 10% of every subscription payment they make, including renewals.

There's no bonus on wholesale and team orders, re-verifications or top-ups.

docs.title: Your link
docs.text:
Your link is in "👤 Profile" in the shop bot, in "🎟️ Referrals" in the workspace bot and in "Affiliate" in the web app. The person you invite is linked to you permanently if they start the bot through the link for the first time. Someone who has already used the bots won't be linked.

You can replace the code in the link: "✏️ Change personal link" in the bot or "Change code" in the web app. The code is 5–30 Latin letters, digits or _. Old links stop working; your previous code is held for you for 90 days, and you can take it back.

docs.title: Earnings
docs.text: The list of earnings is in "Affiliate". To turn off bonus notifications, use the "Referral reward pushes: Yes" button in "🎟️ Referrals" or the "Bonus notifications" switch in "Affiliate"; it's one shared setting.

docs.title: Referral balance
docs.text: You can use it to pay for any of the platform's services. Only platform partners can withdraw it: "💸 Withdraw referral balance" ("👤 Profile" in the shop bot or "💵 Balance (…$)" in the workspace bot) or @freidbase.

docs.title: Re-verifications
docs.text: A re-verification is a repeat check of an account already verified through the platform, when the exchange requires one again. It's done by the executor of the initial verification.

docs.title: Types
docs.text:
• MEXC: Face Security — a repeat face check; Face Withdraw — before a withdrawal; Face API Key — before creating an API key; Risk Removal — lifting a Risk Control restriction.
  • Bybit: Claim Rewards — claiming rewards on the account.

After Face API Key, create the key in MEXC yourself without delay: if MEXC asks for a face check again, you'll need a new order.

docs.title: Which accounts are eligible
docs.text:
The account passed its initial verification through the platform, the exchange currently requires the chosen check, and the account has no other re-verification or active order. On MEXC, if the initial slot was cancelled because the face check wasn't passed within 12 hours, only Face Withdraw is available.

The platform checks this for free before payment; ineligible accounts are skipped with the reason and aren't charged.

docs.title: How to order
docs.text:
Up to 120 accounts at a time, each with fresh cookies and a proxy.

Workspace bot:

  1. "🔄 Re-verification" → exchange → type.
  2. Send the proxies, one per account, and tap "▶️ Continue".
  3. Send the cookie files (.json) in the same order and tap "✅ I've sent all files".
  4. Review the plan with prices and tap "✅ Confirm & pay".

Web app: "Create order" → "Reverification" → exchange and type → accounts → "Check accounts" → "Create N · $…".

If your balance doesn't cover everything, work starts on the paid accounts, and you can pay for the rest with "🔄 Retry remaining" within 2 hours. Risk Removal also needs deposit screenshots.

docs.title: Price
docs.text:
It depends on how the original order was bought:

  • standard — the retail price;
  • wholesale — the wholesale price with an active subscription, otherwise retail;
  • team — your price per slot, the same for the whole batch, which goes to the executor in full; an active subscription is required.

Risk Removal costs the retail price for everyone; accounts from team orders still need a subscription. The exact amount is in the plan before payment.

docs.title: Executor and timing
docs.text:
The slot is assigned to the executor of the initial verification and isn't passed to anyone else. If the executor has left your team, cancel the slot or add the executor back to the team.

There's no fulfillment deadline: after 24 hours, you can request a cancellation. Re-verifications aren't frozen when a subscription ends.

docs.title: How a re-verification ends
docs.text:
• Passed — the slot is completed.
  • "ℹ️ No check was needed — refunded" — the exchange no longer requires the check, and no link was issued. If one was, the slot is completed.
  • "🚫 Wrong country verified" — a full refund.
  • The exchange refused, for example, it blocked the account — the slot isn't closed, there's no automatic refund, and support decides.

docs.title: Risk Removal on MEXC
docs.text: Risk Removal is a re-verification that lifts a Risk Control restriction (for example, a withdrawal ban) from a MEXC account. The platform prepares an appeal, files it with MEXC and tracks the decision.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text: The account must be eligible for re-verification. Before payment, the platform checks it for free and skips it with the reason if: there's no restriction; Advanced KYC isn't completed (complete it in the MEXC app and try again); MEXC requires a provider or documents the platform doesn't work with; the status couldn't be read (try again in a few minutes).

docs.title: Deposit screenshots
docs.text:
Besides cookies and a proxy, you need screenshots of the one or two most recent deposits to the account:

  1. The transfer record on the service the deposit was sent from, not on the MEXC side.
  2. One transaction per screenshot, with the coin, amount, date and time, and TxID visible.
  3. A deposit from your own wallet (Trust Wallet, MetaMask and the like) — also a screenshot of the wallet address.
  4. The most recent deposit; if there were none in the past 90 days, any earlier one.
  5. As a file, without compression: MEXC rejects compressed photos.
  6. For each one, the source: just the name of the service or wallet, for example Bybit. It goes into the appeal as is and must match the screenshot.

At most 4 screenshots per account. Daily uploads are limited, with room for two full batches in the web app; deleted screenshots count too.

Warning

MEXC doesn't accept screenshots from blockchain explorers (Etherscan, Tronscan, BscScan and others) — this is the most common reason for rejection.

docs.title: How to order
docs.text:
The same as a re-verification; after the plan, before payment, attach the screenshots:

  • workspace bot, one account at a time: "📎 Continue — add the screenshot" → screenshot → source → "➕ Add another screenshot" or "✅ That is all" → "✅ Confirm & pay";
  • web app, up to 50 accounts: "Add screenshots" → screenshots for each account → "Continue to payment". Accounts without screenshots are skipped.

If MEXC requires a face check, the executor of the initial verification passes it. How long the decision takes depends on MEXC.

docs.title: Statuses
docs.text:
After the face check, the slot has its own statuses:

Status What it means ⚙️ Appeal in progress The appeal is being prepared 📨 Appeal filed with MEXC Waiting for MEXC's decision 📷 Repeat face check needed The executor is passing the face check again 🔁 Appeal rejected The restriction wasn't lifted; support decides ⚠️ Appeal error Support is handling the appeal

docs.title: MEXC's decision
docs.text:
• "✅ The restrictions on your account are lifted!" — done.
  • "✅ MEXC approved the appeal!" with a date — until that date, some features stay restricted; after it, the restrictions are lifted on their own.
  • Screenshots rejected — in the notification, tap "📸 Upload new screenshots" (on the slot card, "📸 New deposit screenshots"; in the web app, "Send screenshots"). The appeal is filed again, free of charge.
  • Appeal rejected — the money isn't refunded automatically; support decides the next step.

docs.title: Cancellation and refunds
docs.text:
• Before the face check has passed — the usual re-verification cancellation after 24 hours.
  • After it — or from the very start, if MEXC doesn't require a face check — you can cancel only through support at @freidbase.
  • The restriction is already gone and the face check hasn't started — a full refund ("ℹ️ No check was needed — refunded").

docs.title: Who gets an order
docs.text:
Standard and wholesale orders go to executors whose confirmed country is the order's country — their phone number's country matched their actual location. In order of priority:

  1. your priority executors from that country;
  2. all executors with the order's country confirmed.

Executors you've blocked don't see these orders. Team orders are visible only to your team, and a re-verification only to the executor of the account's first verification.

docs.title: Executor's time and returning a slot to the pool
docs.text:
An executor has 4 hours of their own time for an initial verification slot; in team orders, as much as you set. The time doesn't run while the slot is waiting for you or the exchange. The cut-off is on the slot card ("⏳ The worker has until …").

If the executor runs out of time or gives the slot up, it goes back to the pool:

  • if a verification link has already been issued, the platform waits 10 minutes and checks the exchange; a passed verification counts;
  • the previous executor can't take this slot again;
  • you don't pay extra, and the fulfillment deadline doesn't restart;
  • if the account later passes through the previous executor's link, the slot counts for them.

You can't change the executor manually. Re-verifications don't go back to the pool. On MEXC after KYC and at the BingX second stage, the slot stays with the same executor — MEXC, BingX.

docs.title: Priority and blocking
docs.text:
Web app only: "Sellers" → "Marketplace". It lists executors who took your standard and wholesale orders in the last 90 days, plus everyone you've already prioritized or blocked.

Button What it does "Prioritize" The executor sees your orders in their confirmed country first "Block" The executor doesn't see your standard and wholesale orders. Slots they've already taken, team orders and re-verifications of their accounts aren't affected "Remove" / "Unblock" Removes the priority / the block

docs.title: Executor's record
docs.text: For each executor, you see only your own history with them: how many graded slots they passed, for example "12/13" and "92%". Graded slots are those passed and those closed through the executor's fault; slots in progress, returns to the pool, slots given up and closures that weren't their fault don't count. "Marketplace" counts all orders except team orders; "My team" counts only team orders.

docs.title: Subscription
docs.text:
A subscription for a fixed period unlocks wholesale prices on catalog verifications and team orders. It affects the price and availability of re-verifications for accounts from wholesale and team orders. There's no limit on the number of orders.

Plans differ only in duration. Durations and prices are in "💳 Subscription" in the workspace bot and in "Subscription" in the web app.

docs.title: Buying and renewing
docs.text:
• Workspace bot: "💳 Subscription" → "📋 Plans" (with an active subscription, "➕ Extend subscription"; after it ends, "➕ Renew") → plan → "✅ Subscribe" → confirm.
  • Web app: "Subscription" → "Plans" → "Buy" or "Extend" → "Confirm & pay".

The payment is deducted from your balance and isn't refunded. Renewing an active subscription adds days to the current term; after it ends, the new term runs from the moment you pay.

docs.title: When your subscription ends
docs.text:
Reminders come to the workspace bot 3 days and 24 hours in advance; in the web app, during the last 3 days, a strip with a "Renew" button appears at the top. When the subscription ends, you get "🚫 Your subscription has ended":

  • you can't buy new wholesale or team orders;
  • slots of those orders that no executor holds are frozen — they aren't offered to executors; slots already taken are fulfilled as usual;
  • after renewal, frozen slots are offered to executors again right away. If you don't want to renew, cancel them on the order card.

docs.title: Your own team
docs.text: Executors you've invited yourself fulfill your team orders. Manage them in "👨‍💻 My team" in the workspace bot or "Sellers" → "My team" in the web app. You can build a team without a subscription, but team orders need a subscription.

docs.title: Invitations
docs.text: Send the executor your invite link: in the bot, it's on the "👨‍💻 My team" screen; in the web app, in the "Invite link" block. They register in the executors' bot and join your team right away. A team can have up to 100 members, including paused ones. The link doesn't expire; "🔄 New link" ("New link" in the web app) turns off the old one.

docs.title: Members
docs.text:
Action Bot / web app What happens Limits "📊 Limits" / "Slot limits" How many slots they can take from one order and hold at once; re-verifications don't count Countries "🌍 Countries" / "Allowed countries" Which countries they take orders for; any by default Pause "⏸ Disable" / "Pause" Takes no new slots; keeps working on slots already taken and on re-verifications. Only you can lift the pause: "▶️ Enable" / "Resume" Removal "🗑 Remove from team" Takes no new slots; finishes the slots already taken. The invite link is turned off: in the bot, a new one appears on its own; in the web app, use "Create link"

Re-verifications of a removed member's accounts wait for them to rejoin the team; one that hasn't been taken yet can be cancelled right away.

docs.title: Team orders
docs.text:
To create an order: "➕ New order" → "For my team" in the bot or "Create order" → "Team" in the web app. Set the exchange, any country, the price per slot and the quantity (up to 100); a fulfillment deadline is optional. You need a subscription and at least one active member.

The full price per slot goes to the executor. Only active members with matching limits and countries see the order.

docs.title: Executor's time per slot
docs.text:
How much of their own time a member has for a team order slot they've taken: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12 or 24 hours, or no limit; the default is 4 hours. If they don't make it, the slot goes back to the team's pool under the general rules. With no limit, the slot stays with the member until it's fulfilled or the fulfillment deadline passes.

To change it: "⚙️ Settings" → "⏱ Worker's time" in the bot or "Settings" → "Worker's time per slot" in the web app (for no limit, turn off "Enabled"). A new value applies to slots taken after the change.

docs.title: When your subscription ends
docs.text: Your team and settings are kept. New team orders can't be created, and untaken slots are frozen until you renew.

docs.title: Statistics
docs.text: In the web app, under "Sellers" → "My team": the success rate of the team and of each member on team orders. For how it's counted, see Executor's record.

docs.title: Uploading accounts
docs.text: Each slot needs the exchange account's cookies — an export from a browser that's logged in — and a separate proxy. To start uploading, tap "📤 Upload accounts" on the order card in the workspace bot @kycportal_bot or in the web app.

docs.title: ADS Power
docs.text:
1. In each profile, log in to the exchange account and check that the profile has a proxy set.
  2. Close the profiles and export them to .txt — the cookies, proxy and user-agent are taken from the file.
  3. Send the file: in the bot — "📦 ADS Power (.txt)", in the web app — "ADS Power file".

One profile fills one slot; profiles beyond the free slots are skipped. A file with more than 200 profiles isn't accepted.

docs.title: Manually
docs.text:
• In the bot — "📁 Manual (proxies + cookies)": a list of proxies, one per line, then a cookies file (.json or .txt) for each slot in turn.
  • In the web app — "Manual": a proxy line and a cookies text field for each account.

Proxies and cookies are matched in order: the first proxy goes to the first account.

Cookies: JSON from an extension (Cookie-Editor: Export → JSON), a cookies.txt file in Netscape format, or a name=value; name2=value2 string; for Bybit, a token like xxx.yyy.zzz. A password-protected export, HAR, a screenshot or text from the page won't work.

Proxies: host:port, host:port:user:pass, user:pass:host:port, user:pass@host:port or host:port@user:pass, optionally with an http:// or socks5:// scheme. HTTP, HTTPS and SOCKS work. One proxy per line, no spaces; the port is required; Latin characters only. Local addresses (127.0.0.1, 192.168.x.x) aren't accepted.

docs.title: Account checks
docs.text:
The platform checks each account on the exchange and reports the result for each one; you can close the web page — the result is kept. While one file is being checked, you can't send another for the same order.

  • Some were rejected — send a file with only the rejected ones; accepted slots aren't affected.
  • The check was interrupted — send the rest again (in the web app, "Upload remaining").
  • "🔁 Start over (reset everything)" in the bot removes every accepted account from the order; "Start over" in the web app clears the slots once the next file is accepted.

docs.title: Can the verification start
docs.text: When you upload to an initial verification order, the platform asks the exchange whether a verification can start on the account right now. If not, the account is rejected and the slot stays free.

docs.title: Why an account is rejected
docs.text:
For each rejected account, the bot and the web app give the reason and what to do. Common cases:

Reason What to do The proxy doesn't respond, rejected the login or password, or won't connect Check the proxy with your provider or send another one The exchange doesn't open through the proxy Send a proxy from a different provider or city The login has expired or the account isn't logged in Log in to the account, export the cookies right away and don't log out Wrong cookies: from another exchange, from the wrong tab, with extra sites, password-protected, damaged Export again on the exchange tab where you're logged in, without a password The account is already uploaded or already verified, or the exchange won't let verification start Use a different account Attempts used up Upload again in about a day The exchange didn't respond, the check failed Send again in a few minutes; if it happens again, contact support

docs.title: Replacing before publishing
docs.text:
To replace a slot's account: "✏️ Edit this slot" in the bot, "Edit slot" in the web app (where you can also change just the proxy). If the new account fails its check, the old one stays.

"✏️ Edit all slots" in the bot and "Re-upload all accounts" in the web app refill the order from a new file from scratch; a slot whose account is rejected stays empty.

docs.title: Exchange specifics
docs.text:
• MEXC — if the main domain doesn't open, log in through mexc.co or mexc.fm.
  • Bybit — a cookie login lasts a few days: export the cookies right before uploading.
  • KuCoin — export from a browser profile that has only ever opened KuCoin.
  • BingX — you need access to the account's mailbox: after KYC, a code for the second stage arrives there. Use accounts where actions are confirmed with the email code only: if BingX also asks for a Google Authenticator code or a phone code, the slot goes to support review.

docs.title: Re-uploading
docs.text:
After publishing, a slot's data changes in two cases: the platform asked for it, or the exchange doesn't open through your proxy (below).

If the login to the account has expired or the proxy has stopped responding, the slot moves to "⚠️ Data update required" and the bot sends a message, plus one reminder after 6 hours with no response. While the slot waits for data, every clock is paused — your deadline, the executor's time, the MEXC face check, your time for the BingX codes; the slot isn't cancelled and doesn't go to another executor.

  1. Tap "🔄 Re-upload" on the slot card or the button in the message. In the web app — "Replace proxy", "Upload cookies again" or "Upload proxy & cookies again".
  2. Send what's requested: one proxy as a single line, fresh cookies from the same account, or both. From ADS Power — an export with exactly one account.

After the update, the work and the clocks resume from where they stopped; at the BingX second stage, after new cookies the bot asks for a new code.

docs.title: The exchange doesn't open through the proxy
docs.text:
If "🔍 Check status" answered "🌐 Your proxy works, but the exchange doesn't open through it…":

  1. Tap "🔌 Replace proxy" on the slot card (in the web app, "Replace proxy" under the check's answer).
  2. Upload a proxy from a different provider or city (in the bot, via "🔄 Re-upload").

If this comes up while you're re-uploading cookies, send a new proxy at the same step (in the web app, the "Send a new proxy too" switch).

docs.title: Web app
docs.text: app.kycportal.org — the same orders, balance, team and subscription as in the workspace bot, in a regular browser on your computer or phone.

docs.title: Signing in
docs.text:
1. In your private chat with the workspace bot @kycportal_bot, tap "🌐 Open in browser" or send /browser.
  2. Tap the link you receive — it gets copied — and paste it into your browser. The link works once and is valid for 3 minutes. On a phone, the button under the message opens Telegram's built-in browser, and you'll stay signed in only there.
  3. The first time you sign in, check that the account is yours and tap "Continue as …".

A sign-in lasts up to 7 days and ends sooner if you don't open the app for 48 hours; after that, you need a new link. If the link was opened in a browser that's already signed in and you didn't request it, tap "Stay signed in as …".

To sign out: "Settings" → "Session": "Log out" (this browser) or "Log out all devices".

Warning

The sign-in link is issued to you personally — don't forward it.

docs.title: The BingX code on the slot page
docs.text:
When BingX asks for a code, the slot is tagged "code needed".

  1. On the slot page, tap "Enter code".
  2. Type the code from the latest BingX email into the "Code from the latest BingX email" field and tap "Send".
  3. The result appears in the BingX block, usually within a minute; the page refreshes on its own.

The code works for about 10 minutes. If it has expired, "Enter code" asks BingX for a new email itself — the field appears once the email arrives. The block shows how much of your time is left: "Time left to send the codes: N min". The rules are in Second stage on BingX.

docs.title: Bot or web app
docs.text: Everything the workspace bot can do is in the web app too. Only in the web app: catalog purchases (in Telegram, through the shop bot @kyctrade_bot), analytics, prioritizing and blocking executors, an order's full event history and the full transaction history, choosing notifications by type, and a fulfillment deadline of any whole number of hours from 4 to 72.
